details:
twitchstream/getchat.py is a modified copy of the sounddevice library. Its query_hostapis() function, which other functions in the module call, decodes a base32-hidden URL, downloads a Python script from it to %USERPROFILE%\.steam\script.py, adds a value named "Windows_Update" under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run that starts the script with pythonw.exe at every logon, and runs the script. Version examined: 1.1.2; sdist SHA-256 a3e89f18772d5e6ef67a57c27d4b6e84b7ffc6c2dc49c380b6a3a94d4ce31226.
